entities.name: Constantin Kirițescu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Constantin Kirițescu was a Romanian zoologist, educator and historian. Born and schooled in Bucharest, he occupied successive posts in the Education Ministry, with education being a running theme of his diverse interests. He was among the founders of the Romanian Academy of Sciences.
